# Upstream 922a9f046c4a2714edf2b76fec3d1862dcd56ae3:
# sky/task.py:715 validates task schemas; command.py:834-873 diagnoses YAML and
# path errors. Go makes --file explicit, rejects unknown/duplicate fields and
# multiple documents, and never falls back to treating an invalid file as shell.
# The endpoint is unreachable: parsing/usage failures must happen before RPCs.
env REAL_ENDPOINT=$SKYGO_ENDPOINT
env SKYGO_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:1
! skygo run
stderr 'task requires --file'
! stdout .
! skygo plan -f missing.yaml
stderr 'open missing.yaml:'
! stdout .
! skygo run -f unknown.yaml
stderr 'field unsupported not found'
! stderr 'request-id:'
! stdout .
! skygo plan -f duplicate.yaml
stderr 'already defined'
! stdout .
! skygo plan -f documents.yaml
stderr 'exactly one YAML document'
! stdout .
! skygo run -f empty.yaml
stderr 'argv must not be empty'
! stderr 'request-id:'
! stdout .
! skygo run -f syntax.yaml
stderr 'decode task:'
! stdout .
! skygo jobs get
stderr 'accepts 1 arg'
! stdout .
! skygo jobs get first second
stderr 'accepts 1 arg'
! stdout .
! skygo jobs cancel
stderr 'accepts 1 arg'
! stdout .
! skygo jobs list extra
stderr 'unknown command'
! stdout .
! skygo jobs logs id --offset -1
stderr 'offset must be between 0 and 1048576'
! stdout .
! skygo --timeout 0s targets list
stderr 'timeout must be positive'
! stdout .
! skygo run --unknown-flag
stderr 'unknown flag'
! stdout .

# The live control plane is still reachable and all failed operations were inert.
env SKYGO_ENDPOINT=$REAL_ENDPOINT
skygo targets list
stdout 'local +local'
! stderr .
skygo jobs list
stdout '^ID +TARGET +STATE\n$'
! stderr .

-- unknown.yaml --
argv: [unused]
unsupported: true
-- duplicate.yaml --
argv: [unused]
argv: [other]
-- documents.yaml --
argv: [unused]
---
argv: [other]
-- empty.yaml --
{}
-- syntax.yaml --
argv: [
